scope: Manual/AI restored image replacement in iCloud Photos
sources_relied_upon: Configured update directory, iCloud Photos directory, and backup/report locations
Existing iCloud import safety patterns and project configuration utilities
material_decisions: Only top-level files named <original-stem>_restored.<extension> are candidates; duplicate, missing, and ambiguous original identifiers are not guessed or changed.
Candidates are rendered as JPEGs with DateTime, DateTimeOriginal, and DateTimeDigitized set to 1955:04:27 12:00:00.
Execution creates and verifies a backup outside iCloud, verifies the copied replacement, then deletes only the exact matching original.
The command is dry-run by default and requires --execute for iCloud changes.
validation_performed: Validated the checked-in YAML configuration loads and resolves its expected directories without producing a report or changing photo files.
open_questions: The user is still adding restored files; no live dry-run or execute run has been performed.
recommended_next_step: After the update directory is complete, run the default dry-run command, review its CSV report, then explicitly rerun with --execute.
